title: Senior Project Manager, Atlassian Cloud Migration
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will lead a strategic migration of a company-wide Atlassian platform from an on-premise setup to Atlassian Cloud. This is a high-visibility program in a complex enterprise environment where technology, information security, risk, compliance, architecture, operations, and business needs all need to move in step.

You will take the program from planning through execution and help secure a smooth, compliant transition with minimal disruption to daily operations. If you enjoy driving cloud transformation in an environment with many stakeholders, clear governance needs, and real business impact, this role offers a meaningful challenge.

Job Description

    You will lead the end-to-end migration program from Atlassian Data Center/Server to Atlassian Cloud.
    You will define and manage scope, timeline, risks, dependencies, and overall delivery structure.
    You will coordinate cross-functional teams across infrastructure, platform, security, compliance, architecture, and business functions.
    You will establish governance forums and provide clear status updates to senior stakeholders.
    You will drive stakeholder engagement, communication planning, and change activities to support adoption.
    You will coordinate vendors and partners where needed and keep all moving parts aligned.
    You will ensure the migration follows enterprise architecture, security, risk, and regulatory requirements.
    You will proactively identify issues and risks and turn them into clear actions and decisions.
    You will oversee testing, cutover planning, business readiness, and the transition to operational support.

Requirements

    Proven track record of leading large-scale enterprise transformation or migration programs successfully.
    Minimum 7-10 years of project or program management experience in complex organizations.
    Experience with SaaS transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, or enterprise platform modernization.
    Strong understanding of project delivery methods including Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid models.
    Ability to manage multiple stakeholder groups and communicate effectively at executive level.
    Experience working with projects that include significant regulatory, risk, and security considerations.
    Strong leadership, facilitation, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
    Ability to work professionally in both Swedish and English.

Nice to have

    Experience with Atlassian products such as Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, and Atlassian Cloud migration programs.
    Experience from banking, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
    Familiarity with data residency, data governance, privacy, and compliance requirements linked to cloud adoption.
    Experience working in large international enterprise environments with distributed teams.
    Project management certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, or equivalent.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Student Assistant
employer: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
description:
Studiehandledare på tyska, 50 %

Internationella Engelska Skolan Växjö söker en engagerad studiehandledare på tyska för en deltidsanställning på 50 %.

Som studiehandledare kommer du att stödja en elev i att utveckla sina kunskaper i olika skolämnen genom studiehandledning på tyska. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med elevens ämneslärare, mentor och övrig berörd personal.Arbetsuppgifter

- Ge studiehandledning på tyska, individuellt eller i mindre grupp.
- Hjälpa eleven att förstå ämnesinnehåll, instruktioner och centrala begrepp.
- Stödja eleven i att använda sina tidigare kunskaper och erfarenheter i den svenska undervisningen.
- Förbereda och följa upp undervisningsinnehåll tillsammans med eleven.
- Samarbeta regelbundet med ämneslärare och mentor för att planera stödet utifrån elevens behov.
- Bidra till att utveckla elevens självständighet, studieteknik och förmåga att delta i undervisningen.
- Dokumentera och följa upp elevens utveckling tillsammans med ansvariga lärare.Vi söker dig som

- har mycket goda kunskaper i tyska,
- har goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska,
- kan förklara innehåll tydligt och anpassa ditt språk efter elevens behov,
- har god samarbetsförmåga och ett professionellt förhållningssätt,
- är lugn, ansvarsfull, organiserad och lyhörd,
- delar skolans höga förväntningar på elevernas utveckling samt vårt fokus på trygghet, studiero och lärande.

Pedagogisk utbildning eller tidigare erfarenhet av arbete som studiehandledare, lärare eller elevassistent är meriterande men inget formellt krav.Anställningsvillkor

- Omfattning: 50 %
- Arbetsplats: Internationella Engelska Skolan Växjö
- Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse
- Anställningsform: Enligt överenskommelse

För arbete i skola krävs att du uppvisar ett giltigt utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister.

Skicka ditt CV och ett kort personligt brev . Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

German-Speaking Study Guidance Support, 50%

Internationella Engelska Skolan Växjö is seeking a committed German-speaking study guidance support worker for a 50% part-time position.

In this role, you will support a student in developing their knowledge across different school subjects through study guidance in German. You will work closely with the student’s subject teachers, mentor and other relevant members of staff.Main responsibilities

- Provide study guidance in German, individually or in a small group.
- Help the student understand subject content, instructions and key terminology.
- Support the student in connecting their previous knowledge and experiences with the Swedish curriculum.
- Prepare and follow up learning content together with the student.
- Collaborate regularly with subject teachers and the student’s mentor to plan support according to the student’s needs.
- Help the student develop independence, effective study habits and the ability to participate fully in lessons.
- Document and review the student’s progress together with the responsible teachers.We are looking for someone who

- has an excellent command of German,
- has a good command of Swedish and/or English,
- can explain content clearly and adapt their language to the student’s needs,
- works collaboratively and maintains a professional approach,
- is calm, responsible, organised and responsive,
- shares the school’s high expectations for student progress and our commitment to safety, calm and effective learning.

A teaching or educational qualification, or previous experience as a study guidance support worker, teacher or student assistant, would be advantageous but is not a formal requirement.Employment details

- Scope: 50%
- Workplace: Internationella Engelska Skolan Växjö
- Start date: By agreement
- Form of employment: By agreement

Employment in a Swedish school requires the successful candidate to present a valid extract from the police criminal-record register.

Please send your CV and a short covering letter. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

title: Kock inom asiatisk matlagning sökes
description:
SVENSKA

Är du vår nästa kock?

Vi är en restaurangverksamhet med fokus på modern asiatisk mat. Nu söker vi en engagerad kock med intresse för asiatisk matlagning som vill bli en del av vårt team i Malmö.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som tycker om att arbeta med asiatisk mat och trivs i ett kök med högt tempo. Du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och arbetar effektivt både självständigt och tillsammans med andra.

Arbetsuppgifterna består bland annat av:

    Tillagning och förberedelse av asiatiska rätter
    

    Förberedelse av råvaror och mise en place
    

    Matlagning efter våra recept och rutiner
    

    Säkerställa kvalitet, smak och presentation
    

    Hålla köket rent och organiserat
    

    Samarbeta med övriga kollegor för att ge våra gäster en bra upplevelse

Tidigare erfarenhet av asiatisk matlagning är meriterande, men det viktigaste för oss är att du är engagerad, arbetsvillig och vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Tillsvidareanställning
    

    Heltid
    

    Fast månadslön
    

    Arbete både vardagar och helger
    

    Ett trevligt och engagerat team
    

    Möjlighet att utvecklas inom verksamheten

ENGLISH

Are you our next chef?

We are a restaurant business focusing on modern Asian cuisine. We are now looking for a motivated chef with an interest in Asian cooking to join our team in Malmö.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with Asian food and feels comfortable in a fast-paced kitchen environment. You are responsible, organised and able to work efficiently both independently and as part of a team.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Preparing and cooking Asian dishes
    

    Preparing ingredients and mise en place
    

    Cooking according to our recipes and routines
    

    Maintaining high standards of quality, taste and presentation
    

    Keeping the kitchen clean and organised
    

    Working together with the team to provide our guests with a great experience

Previous experience with Asian cuisine is an advantage, but most importantly, we are looking for someone who is motivated, hardworking and willing to learn and develop with us.

What we offer

    Permanent employment
    

    Full-time position
    

    Fixed monthly salary
    

    Work on both weekdays and weekends
    

    A friendly and supportive team
    

    Opportunities to develop within the business

TIẾNG VIỆT

Bạn có phải là đầu bếp tiếp theo của chúng tôi?

Chúng tôi là một hệ thống nhà hàng đang phát triển với định hướng ẩm thực châu Á hiện đại. Hiện tại chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm một đầu bếp yêu thích ẩm thực châu Á để gia nhập đội ngũ của chúng tôi tại Malmö.

Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm ai?

Chúng tôi tìm kiếm một người yêu thích công việc bếp và có hứng thú với ẩm thực châu Á. Bạn có tinh thần trách nhiệm, làm việc gọn gàng, nhanh nhẹn và có khả năng làm việc cả độc lập lẫn cùng đồng đội trong môi trường nhà hàng có nhịp độ nhanh.

Công việc bao gồm:

    Chuẩn bị và chế biến các món ăn châu Á
    

    Sơ chế và chuẩn bị nguyên liệu
    

    Nấu ăn theo công thức và quy trình của nhà hàng
    

    Đảm bảo chất lượng, hương vị và cách trình bày món ăn
    

    Giữ khu vực bếp sạch sẽ và ngăn nắp
    

    Phối hợp với đồng nghiệp để mang đến trải nghiệm tốt cho khách hàng

Có kinh nghiệm về ẩm thực châu Á là một lợi thế. Tuy nhiên, điều quan trọng nhất là bạn chăm chỉ, có trách nhiệm, ham học hỏi và muốn phát triển lâu dài cùng chúng tôi.

Chúng tôi cung cấp

    Việc làm lâu dài
    

    Toàn thời gian
    

    Lương cố định hàng tháng
    

    Làm việc cả ngày thường và cuối tuần
    

    Môi trường làm việc thân thiện
    

    Cơ hội học hỏi và phát triển trong công việc

title: Geotechnical Geologist to Gruvteknik
description:
Do you want to use your geological and geotechnical expertise to solve meaningful challenges in one of the world's most advanced underground mining environments? At LKAB, you will contribute to sustainable mining together with experienced colleagues in a supportive, international team where collaboration, learning and long-term development are central.

The sustainable transformation begins with us

We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transform. So that we can live the lives we want, both today and tomorrow. In the same way that we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally.

Would you like to be part of laying the foundation for the way we live – and for the world around us?

Your role

As a Geotechnical Geologist, you will help build and develop the geotechnical understanding that supports safe, sustainable and future-oriented underground mining. You will work with data collection, geological and geotechnical modelling, technical studies and project development, always in close cooperation with colleagues from different specialist areas. The role gives you the opportunity to contribute with your expertise while continuing to learn from others across geology, rock mechanics, seismology, numerical modelling and project management. 

In the role, you will for example: 

    Coordinate geotechnical data acquisition, modelling and model application
    Plan and budget drilling programs in collaboration with relevant stakeholders
    Create, maintain and improve geotechnical models
    Contribute to technical studies and reporting
    Participate in infrastructure and mining development projects
    Collaborate with consultants and internal stakeholders on critical mining studies

What you bring

We are looking for someone who enjoys analysing complex information and translating it into useful insights. You work in a structured way, take initiative when needed and value working together with others. You communicate clearly, ask questions when something needs to be understood more deeply and are motivated by contributing to solutions that make a difference for both operations and people. 

To be eligible for the role, you need to have: 

    A Master of Science degree in Mining Engineering, Engineering Geology, Geology or another related field.
    Experience from exploration geology or engineering geology.
    Experience from underground mining environments.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken; proficiency in Swedish is highly desirable.
    A valid driving license equivalent to Swedish category B.

It is also an advantage if you have:

    Experience with geotechnical logging and modelling, preferably using Leapfrog.
    Experience with geotechnical databases, such as AcQuire, Imago or Imdex.
    Knowledge of rock mass characterization systems.
    Experience with technical report writing and working with large geotechnical datasets.

We encourage applications from candidates whose experience may not align with every listed requirement but who are enthusiastic about the opportunity, passionate about the industry and confident in their ability to succeed in the role.

What we offer

In addition to the general benefits we offer — which you can find a bit further down — we can also offer the following to those who do not currently live in Sweden:

    Relocation support for you and your family.
    Excellent conditions for settling in. We guide you through the official procedures necessary to settle in the country if you come from outside Sweden. We also provide temporary accommodation for a reasonable period and help you find a permanent place to live according to your personal needs.
    LKAB helps you learn Swedish, a tool for a better understanding of Swedish culture.
    The Swedish vacation law entitles all employees to five weeks of vacation per year, and four consecutive weeks during June, July, or August. Your contract may include extra vacation days.

Additional information

We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we usually do not request cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your skills and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible.

Type of Employment: Permanent, full-time, daytime

title: Quantitative Risk Analyst, Credit Risk Data Management
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description:
Job ID: 5814

We are looking for Quantitative Risk Analyst [Assistant/Regular/Senior] from all background and level to join our Risk Models Data and Strategy teams that is recognized for its professionalism, competence and capabilities.

Do you enjoy working with data analysis? Do you like solving problems and finding new and innovative solutions? Do you understand the principles of banking and are you able to apply this knowledge in your daily work?

If you have previous experience with Credit Risk models, then great! If you have a flair for data and a genuine interest in analysis, you are also welcome!

About our team

Meet the Credit Risk Data Management, a part of the Risk Models Data & Strategy organization in Risk Models. We have an ambitious development plan for development of IRB models and together with our colleagues in Nordea we’ll be part of creating the future of banking.

The Risk Models Data & Strategy department, is a department consisting of 6 team, each specialized in their own part of ensuring high quality data is supporting the bank capital foundation. We add value to Nordea and our customers by improving Nordea data quality, helping visualizing and create the understanding of our data so modelling teams can build great internal models used for Own Funds calculation and the for risk management.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What you’ll be doing

As a Quantitative Risk Analyst, the specific role may vary based on qualifications, but you could i.e. play a valuable role in Data analytics, optimizing data flows, product management or as a data governance specialist. Your role could also include coordinating data related activities and ensuring proper communication within the teams and across other Risk Models areas.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Root-cause analysis for data quality issues, where we meticulously investigate and identify the underlying reasons for any discrepancies in our data. This is closely followed by data reconciliation, ensuring that our data sets are consistent and accurate across different sources.
    We focus on optimizing data flows and algorithms to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our data processes.
    Own and manage all data used in credit risk models across the end-to-end lifecycle, applying data product mindset to capture, enhance and realize value throughout credit risk models.
    Identify and govern critical data elements though strong knowledge of credit risk models, regulatory expectation and capital.
    Secure our Data Governance framework and processes with focus on effective Data Quality Controls, also ensuring documentation of Data Lineage toward all data providers and consumers for credit risk data.

title: Student Research Assistant (Amanuens)
description:
We have the power of over 50,000 students and co-workers. Students who provide hope for the future. Co-workers who contribute to Linköping University meeting challenges of today. Our fundamental values rest on credibility, trust and security. By having the courage to think freely and innovate, our actions together, large and small, contribute to a better world. We look forward to receiving your application!

Are you interested in working with communication, outreach and events related to development research? We are looking to hire a student assistant (amanuens) to work with the secretariat of the Swedish Development Research Network (SweDev).

The position

SweDev was founded in 2019 and is a network that connects development researchers across Sweden in order to strengthen collaboration within the research community and to increase interaction between development researchers and practitioners.

Duties for a student assistant can include teaching, administration or participation in research or artistic research. The duties for this position will focus on assisting the SweDev secretariat by maintaining the website, communicating within and outside the network, co-organising and disseminating information about events, monitoring relevant activities and new research findings, and participating in the regular meetings of SweDev's executive committee and steering group.

The person we need

For employment as an amanuens, you must be admitted to higher education at undergraduate or advanced (master's) level.

The person we need is a strong communicator who works independently, is well organised, collaborates well and has an interest in working with digital communication.

The following education, experience and expertise are required:

    experience in development studies, environmental science or political science (Bachelor's degree or ongoing master's studies)
    knowledge of Swedish development cooperation and development-related research
    proficiency in English, spoken and written.

In addition, the following education, experience and expertise will strengthen an application:

    experience of managing social media and/or a website for an organization, or similar experience
    earlier experience of working in the development sector, in Sweden or abroad
    interest in development research and SweDev's work.

The workplace

From the autumn of 2026, SweDev's secretariat will be hosted at https://liu.se/en/organisation/liu/tema – Environmental Change and the Centre for Climate Science and Policy Research (CSPR) at Linköping University.

More information about the activities at the department and unit can be found at https://liu.se/organisation/liu/tema/temam

The employment

The employment is a fixed-term position with a scope of 20 per cent of full-time for up to one year, with possible extension. Starting date as agreed.

An employment as an amanuens is regulated in Chapter 5 of the Higher Education Ordinance.

Salary and employment benefits

Salary according to LiU's central agreement on teaching assistans salaries.

More information about employee benefits is available https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/employee-benefits.

Union representatives

Information about union representatives, see https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/hjalp%20for%20sokande.

Application procedure

Apply for the position by clicking the "Apply" button below. Your application must reach Linköping University no later than September 25, 2026.

Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered.

We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - diversity enriches our work and helps us grow. Preserving everybody's equal value, rights and opportunities is a natural part of who we are. Read more about our work with: https://liu.se/en/article/lika-villkor/.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Linköping university has framework agreements and wishes to decline direct contacts from staffing- and recruitment companies as well as vendors of job advertisements.

title: Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment
description:
Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen, Switzerland is part of the Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine (J\&J IM) Supply Chain organization and is currently recruiting for a  
Senior Project Manager Construction Pharma  
The Senior Project Manager serves as a senior technical leader on capital projects, ensuring alignment to J\&J standards and regulatory requirements. This role leads large capital projects, partnering with Quality, EHS, Operations, and external A\&E/CM firms.  
Key Responsibilities  
Strategic Project Leadership \& Delivery  
Lead large capital projects across all project phases (planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning).  
Coordinate multi\-functional engineering strategies to meet schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements.  
Technical Authority \& Governance  
Act as the senior technical authority, review and approve engineering design changes, and technical submittals.  
Ensure engineering solutions align with J\&J standards, industry codes, and regulatory expectations.  
Budget \& Cost Management  
Lead multi‑million‑dollar capital budgets for assigned projects, monitor costs, and support procurement and contractor selection and evaluation.  
Participate in contractor bid reviews and support value\-engineering decisions.  
Scheduling, Risk \& Performance Management  
Lead schedule development and integration with program timelines; identify critical path items and drive mitigation.  
Maintain a proactive risk register, recommend mitigations, and track performance metrics.  
Construction Management \& Field Leadership  
Provide senior owner\-side engineering oversight during construction and commissioning; ensure contractor performance aligns with design intent and J\&J EHS standards.  
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure EHS compliance on site.  
Documentation \& Reporting  
Maintain detailed engineering records, design documentation, and as\-built information.  
Prepare and present executive\-level status updates, technical summaries, and risk briefings.  
Education \& Experience  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management required; Master’s degree preferred.  
10\+ years of experience leading capital projects, preferably in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similar).  
Demonstrated owner\-side engineering leadership and experience working with A\&E and Construction Management firms.  
Experience leading multi\-discipline teams and collaborating with quality, EHS, operations, and external consultants.  
Skills \& Competencies  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent communication and leadership skills for multi\-functional and executive interactions.  
Proven track record to lead budgets, schedules, and complex contractor relationships.  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for facilities in regulated industries.  
Proficiency with project management and engineering documentation tools.  
Additional Requirements  
Location of Role: Primary Location: Schaffhausen, Switzerland  
Language Requirements: Proficiency: English \& German  
Travel Requirements: This position will require limited travel (less than 10%) domestic and international travel jpidfb0434cjm jit0729jm jiy26jm

title: Collaborateur Sécurité, Santé et Hygiène  à 60%
description:
Collaborateur Sécurité, Santé et Hygiène (H/F/D) à 60%  
Les Usines Métallurgiques de Vallorbe SA (UMV) sont reconnues au niveau international comme le partenaire préféré des professionnels les plus exigeants pour ses outils de précision. Disposant de grandes capacités d’innovation, la société, forte de près de 200 collaborateurs, commercialise ses produits dans plus de 80 pays via un réseau de distribution.  
Dans le cadre d’une création de poste suite au développement de nos activités, nous sommes à la recherche d’un/e  
Collaborateur Sécurité, Santé et Hygiène (H/F/D) à 60%  
Vos missions  
Il ou elle assure une présence terrain régulière et contribue à la mise en œuvre et au suivi opérationnel des mesures de santé, sécurité \& hygiène définies par le Responsable SSH. Il ou elle appuie les équipes de production, de maintenance et d’infrastructure dans l’application quotidienne des règles de sécurité.  
Cette fonction est distincte du rôle de spécialiste MSST reconnu selon l’Ordonnance sur les qualifications des spécialistes de la sécurité au travail, qui reste porté exclusivement par le Responsable SSH.  
Vos activités :  
Réaliser des tournées de sécurité régulières sur le terrain et contrôler l’application de la politique SSH et des points sécurité \& santé (feu, gaz, matériel de sécurité, matériel de secours, EPI),  
Participer à l’élaboration des documents opérationnels de sécurité, en appui du Responsable SSH,  
Travailler en collaboration avec le Responsable SSH à la réduction des risques du site,  
Gérer les équipements de protection individuelle (attribution, contrôle, renouvellement, traçabilité),  
Mettre à jour la documentation relative aux contrôles et aux mesures terrain,  
Remonter les points sécurité au Responsable SSH et participer à l’amélioration des statistiques incidents, presqu’accidents et accidents,  
Analyser les événements terrain, proposer des plans d’actions correctifs et en assurer le suivi,  
Participer aux projets et actions en lien avec le secteur SSH et les différents secteurs de production,  
Participer à l’organisation des exercices d’évacuation pour le personnel,  
Assurer un appui administratif au groupe des Samaritains, en soutien du Responsable SSH,  
Assurer un soutien opérationnel dans le suivi des accès (clés, logiciels de contrôle d’accès),  
Gérer les vêtements de travail, les vestiaires, l’infirmerie et le matériel d’urgence,  
Instruire les collaborateurs aux exigences SSH,  
Planifier et coordonner les formations terrain (quart d’heure sécurité, causeries, exercices pratiques),  
Communiquer au Responsable SSH le suivi des indicateurs et constats terrain,  
Collaborer avec les prestataires externes pour les aspects opérationnels et remonter les informations au Responsable SSH pour la prise de décision.  
Compétences professionnelles et personnelles  
Faire preuve de discernement et de confiance en soi  
Être apte à gérer des situations de conflit  
Être doté d’une capacité d’observation, d’analyse et de synthèse  
Être à l’aise dans les contacts humains et l’expression en public  
Être à l’écoute et avoir la capacité à conserver distance et lucidité  
Force de proposition  
Respecter les valeurs de l’entreprise  
Gestion du stress  
Discrétion.  
Formation base et continue  
Formation de base en sécurité au travail (PERCO STPS ou Assistant de sécurité STPS)  
Expérience de min. 2 à 3 ans, idéalement dans le domaine HSE  
Expérience avec les logiciels de contrôle d’accès Sipass et Salto un atout  
Chargé de sécurité en protection incendie AEAI un atout  
Formation en premiers secours/samaritain un atout  
Maîtriser des outils MS office  
De langue maternelle française ou niveau minimum C1, toutes autres langues constituent un atout.  
Début de l’activité : de suite ou à convenir  
Type de contrat : CDI  
Lieu de travail : Vallorbe

title: Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval
description:
Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

title: Leitende Ärztin, Leitender Arzt für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie Region Bern (Facharzt/-ärztin - Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie)
description:
Die Psychiatrie des Spitals in der Region Bern bietet anspruchsvolle Arbeitsplätze für Ärztinnen und Ärzte, Psychologinnen und Psychologen mit der Möglichkeit zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung mit Rücksicht auf die eigenen Ressourcen. In dem überschaubaren Betrieb prägt die Persönlichkeit jedes Mitarbeitenden die Art des Umgangs miteinander und der Zusammenarbeit. Individualität betrachten wir als Bereicherung. Die Klinik bietet Arbeitsplätze an zwei Standorten in der Berner Region und ist SIWF-anerkannt sowie eine zertifizierte Weiterbildungsstätte.

Zur Führung der Teams suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Persönlichkeit als

Leitende Ärztin, Leitender Arzt für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie für die Region Bern.

Bei dieser besonderen Vakanz erwartet Sie eine vielseitige und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe mit vielen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten und einer engen interprofessionellen Zusammenarbeit. Freuen Sie sich auf eine Arbeit in einer traumhaften alpinen Lage, die Ihnen zahlreiche attraktive Freizeitaktivitäten bietet.

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

- Die ärztliche Leitung des Bereichs, bestehend aus einer Kriseninterventionsstation, einer Tagesklinik und einem Ambulatorium in Absprache mit der Bereichsleitung
- Sie sind Verantwortlich für die Pflege aller psychiatrischen Angelegenheiten und bilden die Schnittstelle zwischen niedergelassenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, der Somatik und anderen Kooperationspartnern.
- Zudem unterstützen Sie Ihre Kollegen, wobei Ihnen dabei kompetente und engagierte Teams zur Seite stehen, die sich auf Verstärkung freuen.
- Als Mitglied des Leitungsgremiums der Psychiatrie haben Sie die Möglichkeit, relevanten Einfluss auf die strategische Ausrichtung des Gesamtbetriebs zu nehmen.

EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)
- Freude an interprofessioneller und interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit sowie an der Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung des Behandlungs- und Therapieangebotes
- Sie leben eine sozialpsychiatrische, flexible, freundliche und dienstleistungsorientierte Grundhaltung

- Aufbau und Leitung des psychiatrisch-psychotherapeutischen Ambulatoriums
- Mitgestaltung und konzeptionelle Weiterentwicklung des Zentrums für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie
- Der Stellenantritt kann per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung erfolgen
- Einen freien Tag. Mitarbeitende aus allen Abteilungen können an einem Ski-, Velo-, Töff-, Wander-, Fun-, Weihnachtsmarkt- oder Kulturtag teilnehmen.
- Spitaleigene KITA
- Ein Team, das in einem innovativen Betrieb ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima lebt.

- Regelmäßige Supervision, interne und externe Weiterbildung

Das Spital arbeitet in interprofessionellen und interdisziplinären Teams, um Menschen ganzheitlich – physisch und psychisch – zu behandeln. Die hohe Weiterempfehlungsrate zeugt vom großen Vertrauen in das Spital und seine Mitarbeitenden.

title: Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger / Pflegefachperson (m/w/d) für Einrichtungen in den Schweizer Alpen (Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger/in)
description:
Du wünschst dir bessere Arbeitsbedingungen, ein spürbar höheres Gehalt und die Berggipfel direkt vor der Haustür? Für verschiedene renommierte Akutkliniken, Rehabilitationseinrichtungen und Pflegezentren in den Schweizer Alpen suchen wir motivierte Pflegekräfte aus Deutschland und der EU.

Wir von SWISSMEDICAL sind dein persönliches Sprungbrett über die Grenze. Als spezialisierter Partner begleiten wir dich Schritt für Schritt bei deinem Wechsel in die Schweiz. Wir vermitteln dich direkt in erstklassige Schweizer Gesundheitseinrichtungen – absolut kostenfrei und perfekt auf deine Wünsche abgestimmt.

**Einsatzbereiche:** Akutkliniken, Ambulatorien oder soziale Einrichtungen
**Ort:** Schweizer Alpen (z. B. Graubünden, Wallis, Berner Oberland)
**Anstellungsart:** Vollzeit (Festanstellung)

Gutes Gehalt, ein hervorragender Betreuungsschlüssel und die Alpen direkt vor der Haustür? Die Schweiz bietet dir genau die Wertschätzung und Lebensqualität, die du in deinem Pflegealltag oft vermisst.

„Weniger Stress, mehr Zeit für den Patienten und eine Lebensqualität, die ihresgleichen sucht. Der Wechsel in die Schweiz war die beste Entscheidung meines Lebens.“

Deine Vorteile im Überblick

- **Top-Vergütung:** Attraktives Jahresgehalt (ca. 75.000 bis 95.000 CHF je nach Erfahrung) mit im Vergleich zu Deutschland moderaten Steuerabzügen.
- **Entspannter Pflegealltag:** Ein deutlich besserer Pflegeschlüssel sorgt für mehr Zeit pro Patient und nachhaltig weniger Belastung im Schichtdienst.
- **Höchste Lebensqualität:** Leben, wo andere Urlaub machen – Skifahren, Biken und Wandern direkt vor der Haustür.
- **Rundum-Sorglos-Relocation:** Volle Unterstützung bei der Diplom-Anerkennung (SRK), den Behördengängen für die Aufenthaltsbewilligung sowie der Wohnungssuche.
- **Moderne Arbeitsumgebung:** Erstklassig ausgestattete Häuser, strukturierte Einarbeitung und ein wertschätzendes, kollegiales Team.
- **Weiterbildung:** Großzügige Budgets und Freistellungen für deine berufliche Entwicklung.

Deine Aufgaben:

- Empathische und fachgerechte Grund- und Behandlungspflege in deinem Fachbereich.
- Planung, Durchführung und digitale Dokumentation der Pflegeprozesse.
- Konstruktive Zusammenarbeit im interdisziplinären Team aus Ärzten, Therapeuten und Pflegekräften.

Das bringst du mit:

- Freude am Beruf, hohe Fachkompetenz und Lust auf eine neue Herausforderung in den Schweizer Alpen.
- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger, Krankenschwester oder Pflegefachkraft (m/w/d).

Security & Identity

Cloud Security

Data Security & Compliance

- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.

- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.

description:

Our tech stack: AI, AI Agents, Cloud, Confluence, Support, JIRA, Security, SharePoint. Requirements: - Professional experience in software engineering, automation engineering, systems integration, internal tooling, or a comparable hands-on technical role.

- Strong practical programming or scripting skills and experience working with APIs, webhooks, data sources, business systems, and automation or integration tools.

- Design and build internal automation and AI-enabled solutions, including assistants, agents, document workflows, extraction and classification, and knowledge search.
- Build and maintain integrations between AI services and systems such as SharePoint, Teams, Jira, Confluence, Zoho, and other internal tools using APIs, webhooks, scripting, and automation tools.

Solution Ownership & Operations

- Take ownership of solutions beyond the prototype stage, including testing, deployment, monitoring, documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
- Maintain and further develop existing automation and AI solutions across the organization.
- Establish reusable standards for integrations, access controls, testing, monitoring, error handling, documentation, and human review.

AI Enablement & Governance

- Support teams in evaluating automation and AI ideas, developing suitable solutions, and using approved tools effectively.
- Identify and prioritize internal automation and AI use cases based on value, feasibility, effort, data sensitivity, risk, and expected adoption.
- Work closely with IT, Security, Privacy, Quality Management, Regulatory, Legal, and other relevant experts to translate agreed requirements into practical technical controls.
- Work closely with the responsible compliance, security, privacy, quality, AI, and regulatory experts.

Salary: 65000 - 75000 EUR per year. OnlineDoctor AG - More about us and the role:Join OnlineDoctor: Were Expanding!

We are a fast-growing telemedicine company focused on improving access to dermatological care. Our platform uses technology to connect patients with dermatologists, enabling them to receive diagnoses and treatment plans remotely and asynchronously.

Were looking for an AI Enablement & Automation Engineer to help us improve and automate internal processes across OnlineDoctor. You will work closely with teams across the organization to understand their workflows, and identify opportunities for automation, turning them into reliable technical solutions.

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on solving real operational problems. You will build and maintain automations, integrations, internal tools, and AI-enabled workflows, while ensuring that solutions are reliable, maintainable, secure, and appropriate for a regulated healthcare environment.

You will work closely with the responsible compliance, security, privacy, quality, AI, and regulatory experts. You are not expected to make governance or regulatory decisions independently; your responsibility is to understand agreed requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions and operational controls.

What we offer:

- Flexibility: You decide if you want to work remote or if you prefer to visit one of our Offices (Hamburg, St. Gallen, Zürich). We offer you a flexible schedule and a working time model that suits you.
- Learning culture: We offer you a steep learning curve in your daily work and support you in your personal and professional development through regular retro and inspiration sessions as well as advanced training. We are open for ideas and impulses and help you with the implementation.
- Team events: Skiing in Switzerland, white water rafting in Vienna - we regularly get together with our entire team and thus increase our teamwork.
- Fair salary: An attractive salary is a matter of course for us.
- Additional benefits: Free choice of laptop, home office allowance, additional vacation day, etc.
- Our Values: Respect and tolerance are part of our DNA. We actively support diversity and inclusion, believing they are the keys to a successful and healthy company culture.

Work Location & Relocation:
Due to current legal and regulatory reasons, we can only hire team members who live in Germany or Switzerland. If youre based elsewhere but excited to join OnlineDoctor, were happy to discuss and support your relocation to either country.

title: Commercial Excellence Lead (m/f/d)
description:
Within the Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA). Commercial Operations & Strategy Organization, the Commercial Excellence Lead will elevate commercial excellence across the region, enable strong alignment across multiple functions and divisions, and lead commercial-capability readiness for our emerging launch pipeline in EEMEA. Strong, trusted partnership with cluster commercial operations teams is essential to the success of this role. Key stakeholders will be the EEMEA Leadership Team (LT), HHI Commercial Operations, regional Chief Marketing Officers (CMO) & Regional Commercial Leads (RCL), and market Commercial Operations Directors (CODs.)
This is a Band 400 individual-contributor role. The primary location is Switzerland, with secondary locations in the Europe or Middle East time zones may be considered upon further discussion with the hiring manager. The role includes approximately 25% travel within Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa.
Responsibilities:
Commercial Capabilities:  Drive customer engagement evolution in partnership with Digital Engagement teams, ensuring commercial capabilities, segmentation, omnichannel execution and customer insights are translated into improved customer experience and business outcomes.
Relevant focus areas include:
•    Sales Force Effectiveness: Ensure proper Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), target setting, CRM operations and upgrades, and Sales Force of the Future (SFOF) deployment in select markets.  Ensure an ongoing focus on segmentation and targeting and Multichannel Cycle Plans (MCCP) efforts in the region.  Leverage data, analytics and business insights to improve sales force effectiveness in the region.
•    Key Account Management:  Ensure the roll out of Key Account Management and Top Customer programs in the region. Ensure successful capability roll-out and work with Market Access and Franchises to increase access at account level.
•    Commercial Trade Channels: Align with HHI on new capability roll-out and support markets in uncovering Commercial Trade Channel (CTC) opportunities.
Operational Governance & Execution:  Work with all relevant stakeholders to secure the EEMEA Commercial Operations & Strategy (CO&S) vision and business strategies and proactively identify and execute projects and programs of strategic importance to the region and our customers in a timely, effective, and efficient fashion. Be the communicator / connector / catalyst for cross-functional projects managed by extended regional stakeholders. Relevant focus areas include:
•    CO&S Governance: Manage all governance activities for the CO&S department, including setting the agenda for virtual and face-to-face meetings and periodic forum calls with market leads and other relevant stakeholders.
•    Business Impact Measurement: Establish measurement frameworks to evaluate the impact of commercial capability investments, ensuring visibility to adoption, effectiveness, customer outcomes and business value realization.
•    Continuous Improvement: Continue to identify opportunities to drive simplification and harmonization across the region in collaboration with CO&S stakeholders including Digital Human Health (DHH). Support markets and the region in Objective & Key Result (OKR) transformation projects where requested.  Bring external industry best practices and innovative approaches into the region to continuously elevate commercial excellence.
•    Marketing Capabilities: Partner with regional Learning & Development (L&D), CMOs, and RCLs to build and scale marketing capabilities with a focus on L3 next deployment and sustainment.
•    Regional Projects: Ensure the successful deployment of projects associated with regional initiatives, priorities, and experimentations.
Launch Excellence:  Lead commercial-capability readiness that carries our emerging pipeline to flawless launch execution across markets. Relevant focus areas include:
•    Launch Capability Readiness: Partner with RCLs and market teams to ensure markets have the appropriate Go to Market (G2M) planning, segmentation, targeting, field-force sizing, training, forecasting support, and launch playbooks are in place well ahead of launch.
•    Launch Framework & Tracking: Establish a repeatable EEMEA launch-excellence framework and toolkit, with launch tracking that gives leadership visibility to timelines, milestones and risks.
AI-Enabled Commercial Excellence:  Champion the responsible adoption of GenAI across commercial workflows — helping teams work faster and smarter while safeguarding compliance and quality — and explore opportunities to embed AI into sales, marketing, field-force and launch ways of working, in partnership with key stakeholders.
Talent Development:  Build & support commercial-operations talent and capability development across the region.
We are looking for a commercially minded leader with 10+ years across sales, marketing, commercial operations and launch readiness who has successfully deployed commercial excellence capabilities in a complex, multinational environment. Combines strategic thinking with execution discipline, excels at influencing without authority, and has a strong track record of leading change, building capabilities, and translating data and technology into measurable business outcomes.

title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

title: Growth Marketer – E-Commerce
description:
Growth Marketer – E\-Commerce  
Location: Sonnentalstrasse 21, 8600 Dübendorf  
Work model: Hybrid – 4 days in the office  
Who we are  
Pflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest\-growing health\-tech scale\-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500\+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.  
Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40\-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.  
What you'll own  
The paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end\-to\-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well\-maintained feeds.  
Meta \& creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in\-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.  
Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.  
Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day\-to\-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.  
New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.  
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.  
What you bring  
2–5 years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale\-up, or agency  
Hands\-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboard  
A data\-driven understanding of marketing and e\-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendation  
Ownership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for one  
Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and quality  
German and English \- both C1\+  
Nice to have  
Experience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feeds  
Familiarity with Shopify or a comparable e\-commerce platform  
Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies  
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics  
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!

Vous définissez avec les clients les solutions les plus adaptées à leurs situations et développez ainsi une connaissance fine et une relation de confiance privilégiée avec eux. Faisant partie d’une équipe soudée et soutenante, l’exercice de ces métiers permet une grande autonomie mais nécessite de grandes responsabilités et une flexibilité de la part de nos collaborateurs.

Taux d'activité entre 50% et 80%

Stimuler et soutenir les clients et leurs proches en maintenant au maximum leur autonomie et leur qualité de vie en fonction de leurs capacités  
Offrir une écoute et développer un lien relationnel et de confiance  
Collaborer activement aux activités des équipes interdisciplinaires avec un rôle propre vous permettant de valoriser votre métier d’auxiliaire de santé comme partie prenante à part entière du système de santé  
Votre profil et vos compétences  
Certificat d'auxiliaire de santé CRS 120 heures ou certification jugée équivalente (diplôme étranger reconnu par la CRS) ou volonté de suivre la formation  
Intérêt marqué pour l'âge avancé et le maintien à domicile  
Capacité à s'organiser de ère autonome tout en sachant collaborer en réseau et en pluridisciplinarité  
Expérience dans le domaine médico\-social et intérêt marqué pour la santé communautaire  
Sens des responsabilités et éthique professionnelle  
Maîtrise du français à l'oral et à l'écrit  
Bonne aisance avec les outils informatiques et la téléphonie mobile  
Nous offrons  
Un cadre de travail stimulant et chaleureux où l'autonomie du soignant est mise en avant  
Un environnement de travail qui privilègie le contact humain et l'échange  
Un travail passionnant dans un cadre agréable pour le bien\-être des clients  
Des conditions de travail et de rémunération équitables  
Des conditions de prévoyance professionnelle qui s’étendent au\-delà des prestations minimales prévues par la loi  
Les avantages de nous rejoindre  
Plan d’intégration par métier, offres de formations continues riches et variées, possibilités d’évolution professionnelle  
L'équité salariale entre femmes et hommes (certification Fair\-ON\-Pay)  
Rémunération selon la Convention Collective de Travail (CCT) du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois  
Offres avantageuses avec tarifs préférentiels dans des sociétés de services autour du sport, santé et bien\-être et loisirs divers  
Politique de mobilité douce et participation aux frais de transports publics  
Cinq semaines de vacances par année et six semaines dès 50 ans

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

- Die ärztliche Leitung des Bereichs, bestehend aus einer Kriseninterventionsstation, einer Tagesklinik und einem Ambulatorium in Absprache mit der Bereichsleitung

EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)
- Freude an interprofessioneller und interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit sowie an der Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung des Behandlungs- und Therapieangebotes

title: Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger / Pflegefachperson (m/w/d) für Einrichtungen in den Schweizer Alpen (Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger/in)
description:
Du wünschst dir bessere Arbeitsbedingungen, ein spürbar höheres Gehalt und die Berggipfel direkt vor der Haustür? Für verschiedene renommierte Akutkliniken, Rehabilitationseinrichtungen und Pflegezentren in den Schweizer Alpen suchen wir motivierte Pflegekräfte aus Deutschland und der EU.

- Empathische und fachgerechte Grund- und Behandlungspflege in deinem Fachbereich.
- Planung, Durchführung und digitale Dokumentation der Pflegeprozesse.
- Konstruktive Zusammenarbeit im interdisziplinären Team aus Ärzten, Therapeuten und Pflegekräften.

title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert

- Experience administering Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence) including workflow design and governance

Tool Ownership

- Support teams in configuring workflows and collaboration structures that fit how they work

Automation & Operation

- Automate repetitive operational processes such as onboarding/offboarding, license provisioning, and access requests
- Maintain clear documentation for configurations, integrations and operational procedures
- Provide reliable support, monitor critical tools and lead incident responses for outages, access issues and integration failures. OnlineDoctor AG - More about us and the role:Join OnlineDoctor: Were Expanding!

We are a fast-growing telemedicine startup focused on improving access to dermatological care. Our platform uses cutting-edge technology to connect patients with dermatologists, enabling them to take pictures of their skin issues and receive diagnoses and treatment plans remotely and asynchronously.

Were looking for a Systems Administrator to take full ownership of our internal tooling landscape and IT operations. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who is self-directed, detail-oriented, and passionate about improving and professionalizing reliable, secure, and well-governed systems.

You will be the owner of our internal tool ecosystem — responsible for access control, security, integrations, cost management, and operational continuity across all platforms. You will establish clear governance and standards, improve how we provision and protect our tools, and ensure every employee has seamless, secure access to what they need.
